scope: Read-only collection of public 8B records and source. No experiment, swarm join, or network write.
key_findings: 8B uses DHT coordination. This file contains no 13B metadata-store measurements or configuration.
Paper and dashboard disagree on end date, processed tokens, and contributor counts; keep their evidence separate.
Published 8B settings are 40-second matchmaking, 150-second averaging, and 30/60-second state sender/reducer timeouts.
DHT operation latency is available, but it is exported interval-average telemetry, not per-lookup or advertisement-propagation traces.
Paper reports join/drop event counts. Dashboard timestamps support different first-join proxies, not a complete event history.

paper_calendar_dates_utc_proxy.note: Includes May 14 through June 23 in UTC. This 41-calendar-day filter is not the paper's exact 40-day training interval; start/end times and timezone are unreported.

run_identity_and_windows.precision_note: Training API start differs from run-list/telemetry start by one second. Dashboard boundaries are integer seconds; some raw peer/training timestamps exceed them. Original values are retained, without shifting the series.
run_identity_and_windows.discrepancy_status: Reason for longer archive and different counts remains unverified.

paper_reported_reference.event_note: Rejoins count again. Rates divide whole-run totals by 40 days, not public-only exposure or a stationary hazard.
paper_reported_reference.latency_note: Early operations sometimes took seconds; later stabilized. Monitoring gap before public admission affects counts.
paper_reported_reference.roster_note: Some local groups exceeded expected size; head/tail deficits absent, body deficits small.
paper_reported_reference.averaging_note: Only Pluralis workers reduced chunks; contributor bodies experienced more failures.

matchmaking_poll_sleep_default.note: Read/processing time is additional. Runtime overrides unknown.

stage_announcement_lifetime_default_form.note: Stage discovery announcement, separate from a round's matchmaking advertisement.

source_provenance.limit: Published source at the preserved clone revision, not a full deployed-code/config history. Defaults and late source edits must not be treated as proven settings throughout the run.

dashboard_peer_population.note: Archive records are not simultaneous workers or unique averaging groups. Paper population counts are separate.

network_rtt_and_peer_activity.rtt_note: Reported peer network RTT in ms. Measurement timestamps are absent; these stored values cannot be attributed precisely to the paper window or substituted for DHT/visibility delay.
network_rtt_and_peer_activity.bandwidth_note: API up/down fields retained without converting their unverified API units. Paper Mbps figures are separately labelled.

churn.paper_event_totals_and_normalization: See paper_reported_reference; reported events were not independently reconstructed.
churn.proxy_formula: Count joined_at within the labelled window / that window's duration_days.
limits: A node record provides one join and one last-seen timestamp, not all reconnects.
Last-seen time is not a confirmed disconnect.
The UTC date proxy covers 41 calendar days; paper event rates use its reported 40 days.
Final shutdown, partial days, and private/public admission periods preclude assuming stationary churn.

telemetry.aggregation_method: Unweighted finite worker/time cells in each labelled window. Missing cells excluded; quantiles use linear interpolation (statistics.quantiles method=inclusive).
telemetry.latency_definition: DHTNode.get_many/store_many durations that returned normally, accumulated and averaged at roughly 60-second log intervals, converted to ms. No-operation intervals may report zero.
telemetry.rpc_definition: Received rpc_find/rpc_store counts from the reporting interval, subsequently stored as gauges. Decimal export values demonstrate processing beyond the original integer log counts.
critical_limits: The export grid is 10989 seconds (about 3.05 hours), much coarser than ads, reads, or averaging rounds.
Percentiles are across exported interval-average/gauge cells, not percentiles of individual DHT calls.
Unknown dashboard resampling and gauge carry-forward can repeat values; cells are not independent trials.
Zeros may mean no completed timed calls; positive-only latency sensitivity is included.
get_many may include cached paths and batching; durations are not one-way transport or ad-propagation delay.
Call durations are not weighted by operation counts. Incoming RPC counts are different from local timed get/store counts.
Matchmaking has 826 worker labels but the peer table has 592 records; overlap is 496. DHT latency has 169 labels, with 142 overlapping. Cause unknown; both cohorts preserved.
Finite-cell n is not total verified groups, leadership attempts, or successful averaging rounds.
Different epoch/roster observations cannot be aligned without raw round IDs and membership traces.

metric_meanings.mm_time: Seconds logged when a local roster formed, excluding the initial advertisement write.
metric_meanings.formed_groupsize: Size of local roster; not number of groups.
metric_meanings.average_pcnt: Logged percentage of averaged parameter data received.
metric_meanings.reducer_pcnt: Logged percentage of parameter contributions received for reduction.

unavailable: aligned peer rosters and round IDs

matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.normal_publication: One declaration per look_for_group invocation, then membership polling.
matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.formation: Accumulate peers observed across polls; finish when expected stage count is reached or local window ends; sort PeerIDs.
matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.retention: A peer already added to the local accumulated roster is not removed merely because a later poll omits it.
matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.leader_selection: No earliest-expiration leader election in this path.
matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.timer: Starts after declaration returns; request/sleep time can overrun nominal window.
matchmaking_mechanism_from_source.agreement: Sorting orders a set but does not reconcile different observed sets. Harm from disagreement is untested locally.

experiment_relevance: Use 8B settings and DHT backend; keep 13B architecture and data separate.
Use exported DHT interval means for coarse calibration, not a fabricated per-call tail distribution.
Test delay, churn and roster size jointly with honest-failure controls; record actual local per-call timings.
Distinguish regular stage announcements from per-round matchmaking declarations.
Record key/step, read/write times, absolute expiration, every local roster, expected count, chunk allocation, and partial averaging outcomes.
Evaluate roster consistency and group availability; the former Hivemind leadership-success metric is not applicable to this matchmaking path.
Do not infer an attack, deployment success rate, or unique group count from these public aggregates.

embedded_evidence.description: Exact API field selections retain worker labels, timestamps, nulls and values; no paper text or raw network/RPC traces are embedded.
